statement: Ukraine strikes a refinery, oil depot, oil terminal, or power plant in Russia or Russian-occupied territory with drones or missiles between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: YES if Ukrainian military or security officials claim, and Russian federal, regional, or occupation officials acknowledge, an attack on the same refinery, oil depot, oil terminal, or power plant dated between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-31.
failure_condition: No Ukrainian drone or missile attack hit a refinery, oil depot, oil terminal, or power plant in Russia or Russian-occupied territory between 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-31.

statement: Russia and Ukraine agree to a general ceasefire covering all front lines, open-ended or lasting at least 30 days, that takes effect between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: YES if the Kremlin and the Ukrainian presidential office each publicly confirm a ceasefire covering all front lines, open-ended or of at least 30 days, taking effect between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No ceasefire covering all front lines, open-ended or of at least 30 days and agreed by both Russia and Ukraine, took effect between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Saudi Arabia or the Saudi-led coalition conducts airstrikes on Houthi-held territory in Yemen between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: YES if Saudi officials, the Saudi Press Agency, or coalition command announce, or Reuters or AP report citing Saudi officials, Saudi or coalition airstrikes on Houthi-held Yemen occurring between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: No Saudi or Saudi-led coalition airstrike hit Houthi-held Yemen between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-06.

statement: A merchant vessel is seized, boarded without authorization, or hit by a projectile, drone, or mine in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: YES if UKMTO reports a merchant vessel seized, boarded without authorization, or hit by a projectile, drone, or mine in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman, with incident date between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel was seized, boarded without authorization, or hit by a projectile, drone, or mine in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, or Gulf of Oman between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-06.

statement: The ICE Brent December 2026 futures contract settles below 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-29. Reference: 106.95 USD on the packet date.
resolution: YES if the ICE Futures Europe settlement price for the Brent December 2026 contract on 2026-10-29 is below 100.00 USD per barrel. Reference: 106.95 USD on the packet date.
failure_condition: The Brent December 2026 futures contract settles at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-29.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield is at or above 5.50 percent on 2026-11-20. Reference: 5.24 percent on the packet date.
resolution: YES if FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.50 or higher for 2026-11-20. Reference: 5.24 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The 10-year US Treasury constant-maturity yield for 2026-11-20 is below 5.50 percent.

statement: CISA adds a SonicWall SMA 1000 series vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: YES if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendorProject SonicWall, a product field naming SMA 1000 or SMA1000, and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: No SonicWall SMA 1000 series vulnerability was added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.

statement: CISA adds a GitLab vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-11.
resolution: YES if the CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendorProject GitLab and a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-11.
failure_condition: No GitLab vulnerability was added to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-11.

statement: A member of the House Democratic Caucus is elected Speaker of the 120th Congress in a House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: YES if the Clerk of the House roll call electing the Speaker of the 120th Congress, held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15, elects a member of the Democratic Caucus.
failure_condition: No member of the Democratic Caucus was elected Speaker of the 120th Congress in a House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 150 km of the epicenter of USGS event us6000u18k, the M7.7 Panama earthquake, between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12 UTC.
resolution: YES if the USGS ComCat catalog lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 150 km of the us6000u18k epicenter with an origin time between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurred within 150 km of the us6000u18k epicenter between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-12 UTC.
